About Blueprint 

 Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology. 

 Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams. 

 At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build. 

 Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters. 

 
 

 In This Role

 You will help modernize data management, workflow automation, and reporting for complex cloud infrastructure and hardware planning initiatives. By combining AI-powered solutions, data engineering, and business intelligence, you will transform manual, spreadsheet-based processes into efficient, automated, and accessible reporting systems. You will integrate data across multiple platforms, build and maintain Power BI dashboards, and identify opportunities to improve data quality, reduce manual effort, and accelerate decision-making. This role offers an opportunity to apply emerging AI technologies to real-world business challenges while building expertise in cloud infrastructure and enterprise data operations.

 Responsibilities

 
 
 
 
 Assess existing business workflows, establish baselines for manual effort, and identify opportunities for AI-driven automation based on business impact.







 
 
 
 Integrate and consolidate data from SharePoint, Azure DevOps, Excel, and cross-functional databases into a centralized, governed source of truth.







 
 
 
 Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot Power BI dashboards that deliver timely, accurate, and actionable business insights.







 
 
 
 Build and implement AI-powered solutions for workflow automation, data reconciliation, change summaries, natural-language querying, and report generation.







 
 
 
 Automate data refresh processes and implement data validation, quality checks, and reporting controls to improve reliability and consistency.







 
 
 
 Use Power Platform tools and integrations to streamline data collection, processing, reporting, and operational workflows.







 
 
 
 Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and clear, executive-ready visualizations.







 
 
 
 Document technical solutions, develop user guidance, and support adoption of automated workflows and reporting tools.







 
 
 
 Measure and communicate the impact of implemented solutions through metrics such as hours saved, cycle-time reduction, and improvements in data quality.







 
 
 
 Continuously evaluate existing dashboards and processes to identify opportunities for optimization, efficiency, and improved user experience.







 
 Qualifications

 
 
 
 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.







 
 
 
 Experience in data engineering, business intelligence, analytics automation, or a related technical discipline.







 
 
 
 Demonstrated experience implementing AI solutions to improve workflows, automate repetitive tasks, or increase operational efficiency.







 
 
 
 Hands-on experience with Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, Power Query, dashboard development, data refresh, deployment, and row-level security.







 
 
 
 Experience with Microsoft Power Platform tools, including Power Automate and Power Apps, to support business process automation and data-driven solutions.







 
 
 
 Familiarity with Azure DevOps, including queries, Analytics/OData, and REST API integrations.







 
 
 
 Experience working with SharePoint Online, advanced Excel, SQL, and Python for data integration, analysis, transformation, or automation.







 
 
 
 Ability to aggregate and reconcile data from multiple platforms and systems while maintaining data accuracy and consistency.







 
 
 
 Experience developing or implementing generative AI solutions using tools such as Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, AI Builder, or Microsoft 365 Copilot.







 
 
 
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify process inefficiencies and recommend practical improvements.







 
 
 
 Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical solutions, document workflows, and present data insights to business stakeholders.







 
 
 
 Ability to demonstrate a previous AI implementation through a live project walkthrough, without disclosing confidential employer, customer, or proprietary information.







 
 Preferred Qualifications

 
 
 
 
 Experience working with hardware planning, cloud infrastructure, supply-chain data, product roadmaps, or portfolio reporting.







 
 
 
 Experience optimizing AI workloads or implementing AI-enabled workflow improvements in an enterprise environment.







 
 
 
 Experience consolidating data across organizational systems into a centralized reporting or analytics solution.







 
 
 
 Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Dataverse, or Kusto Query Language (KQL).







 
 
 
 Experience with Power Platform application lifecycle management (ALM), Git, or related version control practices.







 
 
 
 Experience developing governed, scalable data solutions with automated refresh processes and data-quality monitoring.







 
 
 
 Relevant certifications in Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, or Azure AI.







 


 Salary Range   

 At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market. For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated salary range is  $90000– $95,000 USD/Annually.   Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final salary and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications and could fall outside the stated range. 

 Location:Remotw
 Benefits 

 Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include: 

 
 Medical, dental, and vision coverage 

 Flexible Spending Account (FSA) 

 401(k) retirement plan 

 Competitive paid time off 

 Parental leave 

 Professional growth and development opportunities 

 
 Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location. 

 Equal Employment Opportunity 

 Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. 

 Applicant Accommodations 

 If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@bpcs.com.
